howto.name: Enter your regex pattern
howto.text: Type the pattern. JavaScript RegExp syntax (same as in MDN docs).

howto.name: Set flags
howto.text: Combine g (global), i (case-insensitive), m (multiline), s (dotall), u (unicode), y (sticky).

howto.name: Paste test text
howto.text: Drop the text to match against. Matches highlight in real time as you edit either field.

howto.name: Read match details
howto.text: Each match is listed with its offset, captured groups, and matched substring.

faq.q: Which regex flavor does it use?
faq.a: JavaScript RegExp (ECMAScript). The same engine that powers browser pattern matching. Most patterns are portable to Python re, PCRE, or Go regexp with minor adjustments.

faq.q: Is my test text saved anywhere?
faq.a: No. Pattern and text are kept in browser state only. Refresh the page and they're gone. No server-side storage.

faq.q: How many matches can it handle?
faq.a: Up to 1,000 matches are found and listed; past that the result says only the first 1,000 are shown. Each check runs in a separate worker and stops after one second, so a pattern that backtracks badly shows an error instead of freezing the page.
